Hacking-Leiter (mittel): Ein autorisiert: Hacking ladder (medium): An authorized pentest at the (made-up) company Nebelwerk GmbH. Ten phases from reconnaissance to the report.
Methodische Aufklärung: Hosts finden, Pf: Methodical reconnaissance: find hosts, search for paths, read tokens and APIs, spot leaks in Git and configs, analyze traffic captures and logs.
Nur das Sandbox-Terminal in diesem Raum: Only the sandbox terminal in this room (~/nebel). SIMULATION – made-up systems, no real network traffic.
None needed – the sandbox is isolated.
Nichts nötig. Dein Fortschritt bleibt ge: Nothing needed. Your progress stays saved.
Operation Nebel · Sandbox bereit. Start:: Operation Nebel · Sandbox ready. Start: cat LIESMICH.txt · help shows commands.
Zonendatei, Pfadsuche, JWT, API, Git, Ko: Zone file, path search, JWT, API, Git, config diff, encoding chain, traffic capture, log correlation.
Aufklärung ist der wichtigste Teil eines: Reconnaissance is the most important part of a pentest – and usually the longest.
Allowed: reconnaissance of all hosts under *.nebelwerk.sim, reading data that the company itself gives away.
NICHT erlaubt: Passwörter raten, Daten v: NOT allowed: guessing passwords, changing data, other targets.
Die Firma hat dir ein paar Unterlagen ge: The company has given you a few documents (in the phase folders).
Jede Phase hat einen Code – mit entsper: Every phase has a code – with  entsperren CODE  you move on.
Bericht abgegeben. Nebelwerk schließt je: Report submitted. Nebelwerk is now closing: open backups, tokens with secrets, old Git entries,
unverschlüsselte Logins und eine vergess: unencrypted logins and a forgotten maintenance page. Good work!
Nebelwerk hat dir seine DNS-Zonendatei g: Nebelwerk has given you its DNS zone file – the company’s "phone book": which name belongs to which IP address. A TXT record (free text) contains something encoded.
grep TXT zone.txt zeigt die Text-Einträg: grep TXT zone.txt shows the text records.
Der Wert in Anführungszeichen beim _veri: The value in quotation marks in the _verify record is Base64.
Auf dev.nebelwerk.sim gibt es ein Verzei: On dev.nebelwerk.sim there is a directory that is not linked anywhere. woerter.txt is a small word list.
Für jedes Wort prüfen, ob /WORT/ existie: For every word, check whether /WORD/ exists: curl -s -I http://dev.nebelwerk.sim/WORD/ | head -1
In einer Schleife: for w in $(cat woerte: In a loop: for w in $(cat woerter.txt); do …; done – grep -q 200 searches quietly (q = quiet) and only reports "found yes/no"; && echo $w then prints the word.
Lösung: for w in $(cat woerter.txt); do: Solution: for w in $(cat woerter.txt); do curl -s -I http://dev.nebelwerk.sim/$w/ | head -1 | grep -q 200 && echo $w; done → curl http://dev.nebelwerk.sim/release/ → notizen.txt
In den Release-Notizen lag ein Anmelde-T: The release notes contained a login token (JWT). JWTs are not encrypted – only encoded.
cut -d. -f2 token.txt gibt den mittleren: cut -d. -f2 token.txt gives you the middle part.
Aus Base64url wird normales Base64, wenn: Base64url becomes normal Base64 when you replace _ with / and - with +: tr '_-' '/+'
Ein JWT hat drei Teile, getrennt durch P: A JWT has three parts, separated by dots: header.payload.signature. The middle part is Base64url (- and _ instead of + and /).
http://api.nebelwerk.sim/v1/mitarbeiter: http://api.nebelwerk.sim/v1/mitarbeiter returns more fields than the website shows.
curl http://api.nebelwerk.sim/v1/mitarbe: curl http://api.nebelwerk.sim/v1/mitarbeiter shows the JSON response.
Ein Datensatz hat ein internes Feld mit: One record has an internal field with hex values.
Lösung: curl http://api.nebelwerk.sim/v1: Solution: curl http://api.nebelwerk.sim/v1/mitarbeiter | grep notiz_intern | cut -d'"' -f4 | xxd -r -p
Nebelwerk hat dir einen Auszug aus „git: Nebelwerk has given you an excerpt from "git log -p". A password was "removed".
Im Git-Verlauf bedeutet - eine entfernte: In the Git history, - means a removed line, + an added one.
Gesucht sind Zeilen, die mit - beginnen: You are looking for lines that start with - and later contain "passwort" (German for password). ^- means "starts with -", .* means "any characters in between": grep "^-.*passwort" git-log.txt
Zwei Versionen der Webserver-Konfigurati: Two versions of the web server config. A section was added in the new one – publicly reachable.
diff nginx-alt.conf nginx-neu.conf zeigt: diff nginx-alt.conf nginx-neu.conf shows the new line.
The path after location is reachable on portal.nebelwerk.sim.
Lösung: diff nginx-alt.conf nginx-neu.co: Solution: diff nginx-alt.conf nginx-neu.conf → curl http://portal.nebelwerk.sim/wartung-…
Eine Nachricht, dreifach verpackt: erst: A message, wrapped three times: first hex, then ROT13, then Base64. Unwrap it in reverse order.
Außen ist Base64: base64 -d: The outer layer is Base64: base64 -d
Ein Mitschnitt aus dem internen Netz (Te: A traffic capture from the internal network (as text). A service logs in over HTTP with "Basic" authentication – which is only Base64, not encrypted.
Lösung: grep Authorization mitschnitt.tx: Solution: grep Authorization mitschnitt.txt | cut -d' ' -f3 | base64 -d

grep \"/admin\" zugriffe.log | grep \" 2: grep "/admin" zugriffe.log | grep " 200" finds successful admin accesses.
